observations: Photo 0: a clean, white Sharp copier with a visible nameplate reading 'SHARP AR-5516', watermarked 'POSTED ON JIJI / DEIMOS INC' - appears to be a stock/catalog image.
Photo 1: a different copier - beige/cream colored, visibly dusty, scratched casing, worn control panel stickers, sitting on a tiled floor in a cluttered room.
Photo 2: the same beige/cream unit as photo 1, dusty, open lid, home-like setting with curtains and a patched wall socket visible in background.
The color, condition, and setting in photos 1-2 do not match the clean white unit in photo 0 - these look like two different physical machines.
No nameplate or model sticker is legible in photos 1 or 2.
No test print, power-on screen, or toner/drum shot in any photo.

claims.claim: Selling a Sharp AR-5516 Digital Photocopier
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a clean white AR-5516 nameplate, but photos 1 and 2 show a visibly different, worn, beige-colored unit with no matching nameplate - the actual item being sold does not appear to be the one pictured in photo 0.

claims.claim: ideal for office use, business centers, cybercafes
claims.evidence: No functional test, printout, or power-on shot provided.

risks.risk: Seller may be using a stock/catalog photo (photo 0) to represent a different, more worn actual unit (photos 1-2), misrepresenting condition or even model.
risks.proof: A single photo of the actual unit for sale showing its nameplate/model sticker clearly, taken in the same setting as photos 1-2.
risks.if_unproven: treated as unidentified/unverified item condition - priced at worst case as a heavily used, unverified-model unit, not as the clean AR-5516 shown in photo 0.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or may not produce prints.
risks.proof: Video of unit powering on and producing a test copy/printout.

risks.risk: Toner/drum/fuser condition and page count unknown, affecting remaining usable life.
risks.proof: Photo of the internal consumables (drum, toner cartridge) and a service/counter screen showing total page count.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged paper trays, cables, or accessories not shown.
risks.proof: Full-unit photo showing all trays closed and accessory/cable bundle included.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual unit being sold with its nameplate/model sticker clearly visible.
Video of the unit powering on and producing a test copy.
Photo of the page counter/service screen.
Photo of toner and drum unit condition.
response.reason: The lead photo appears to be a clean stock image of a Sharp AR-5516, while the other two photos show a visibly different, worn unit in a different setting with no legible model plate - a classic bait-and-switch pattern that must be resolved before any price can be assigned.
